lead: Command output: a dark terminal panel with the title, the status (running / done / failed + exit code) and a copy button in its header, and the output below. It understands ANSI colors and styles, follows new output while running if you are at the bottom, and copies plain text with the escape sequences removed.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Append the output line by line with `status="running"`, then switch to `done` when it finishes.

api.title: API Reference
api.helpers: Helpers, also exported for your own use:
api.ansi: Parses the output into lines of styled segments (color, bold…) / returns the plain text with every escape sequence removed

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.terminal: Panel root (dark in both light and dark mode); `data-status`
styling.copy: Copy button; `data-copied` right after a successful copy
styling.output: Output area (`pre`, `role=region`, focusable); its height limit reads `--term-lines`
styling.line: A line, and the `$` before the command line
